description: Set the work status (todo, in_progress, or dismissed for not an issue) or the assignee of a whole Site Health issue: every unresolved finding of one check across the website, in one write, as the status and assignee controls on an issue do. Omit a field to leave it as it is; unassign true (or assignee_user_id null) unassigns every page. Returns how many task rows changed; a repeated write changes none. The assignee is emailed once for the pages they now hold. Signed-in connections only: an API key has no teammate to act as, so API-key connections are not offered this tool and a direct call is refused with 403. Requires Site Health on the website's plan; otherwise the call fails with 403.

assignee_user_id.description: A teammate with analytics access on the website, as get_user_by_email or an earlier assignee.id gives it; null unassigns every page (chat tools send unassign true instead); absent leaves assignees as they are.

check.description: The check id of the issue, from the issue list.

unassign.description: true clears the assignee. Chat tools must use this: a null assignee_user_id is dropped as unspecified. Cannot be sent with an assignee_user_id.

work_status.description: todo, in_progress or dismissed (not an issue).

name: update_site_health_issue
